A '''Phuii''' [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] participated in the [[Ungasan Cross Country]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]<ref name="SJ" /> sometime before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="time" /> The [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] fatally crashed in the [[Juaka Canyon]]. Years later, the remains of the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer's]] pod served as the site of a conflict between the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ree]] and a group of Ando Prime's native [[Talid/Legends|Talids]].<ref name="SJ" />
